facts.fact: President Boko said in the State-of-the-Nation Address that the government is undertaking the operationalisation of a Single Social Registry for beneficiary registration, alongside Proxy Means Testing.

systems.owner: Ministry of Local Government and Traditional Affairs

facts.fact: The World Bank completion report says 98 percent of beneficiaries of the five main social assistance programmes targeting poor households were included in the Single Social Registry by March 2025.
Ministry of Local Government's social protection director Manne said the Single Social Registry is 96 per cent complete and has captured 18 social protection programmes.

note: The document states nothing this study asks for Botswana.

facts.fact: Finance Minister Gaolathe's 2026/27 budget speech said there was an urgent need to accelerate the rollout of the Single Social Registry, with the World Bank to assess bottlenecks.
BETP secretariat's Tselakgopo said government was establishing a Single Social Registry to identify and target the most vulnerable citizens.
